item.wayfarers_atlas.atlas.tooltip: Carry it (or wear it in a Curios slot) to use the map. Press J to open.
screen.wayfarers_atlas.name: Name
msg.wayfarers_atlas.need_atlas: You need an Atlas to use the map
wayfarers_atlas.configuration.title: Wayfarer's Atlas settings

item.wayfarers_atlas.atlas.no_upgrades: No pages. Right-click a page onto the Atlas in your inventory
